# StackEnv

StackEnv is an open-source, read-only inventory and command center for development machines.

Documentation: https://stackend.codelynx.dev/docs
Skills sync: https://stackend.codelynx.dev/skills-sync
VPS skills setup: https://stackend.codelynx.dev/skills-sync/vps
Computer skills setup: https://stackend.codelynx.dev/skills-sync/local
Source: https://github.com/Melvynx/stackenv
Releases: https://github.com/Melvynx/stackenv/releases

Core concepts:
- Discover projects, nested applications, and all Git worktrees.
- Read Portly-supervised application state.
- Index screenshots by feature.
- Serve an authenticated dashboard and API on loopback.
- Allow optional, scoped media bypass URLs for coding agents.
- Expose the dashboard through Cloudflare Tunnel.
- Synchronize ~/.agents between a VPS and computer using the documented private Git worker.
